kinematic.telemetry_basis: Quaternion-derived yaw and pose-derived u/v/r with wrapped angular differences; all samples 0-2399 included and no fixed startup exclusion.
kinematic.definition: Calm Node and VRX displacement vectors from the common serialized reset, evaluated at the three preregistered checkpoints. The 30% / 15 degree cross-simulator scale replaces the inapplicable 1e-4 deterministic-runtime threshold.

environment_response.definition: Paired environment-on minus environment-off N/E displacement for each simulator, evaluated independently per seed at each preregistered checkpoint.
